mapper.select: SELECT pp.id AS id, pp.project_id AS projectId, pp.total_count AS totalCount, pp.inspected_count AS inspectedCount, p.id AS planId, p.plan_name AS planName, p.start_time AS startTime, p.end_time AS endTime, p.status AS status FROM inspect_plan_project pp JOIN inspect_plan p ON pp.plan_id = p.id AND pp.project_id = #{projectId} AND p.status = 1 ORDER BY pp.id DESC LIMIT 1
